questions: Does native v3 initialization grow faster than warm shape migration?
Does static-no-sharing Q training grow held-out strict solve ability faster than SKM training?
Is an 0.80 retention promotion threshold discriminative at the same registered dose?
primary_selection: heldout strict successes at target upper minus one
heldout relaxed successes at the current upper when strict successes tie
strict successes per scheduled network evaluation
promotion_rule: Select exactly one training process only after both arms finish the paired panel; fail closed and raise the common evaluation dose if every registered statistic ties; use retention as a reported safety axis and flag below 0.80 rather than declaring 0.80 mathematically optimal.
continuation: Launch only the selected process locally with a six-logical-core cap; checkpoint every 20 introduced identities and retain resumable state.
